name: skill-reviewer
description: Use when reviewing a Claude Code skill, auditing skill quality, or checking whether a skill is ready to publish. Produces structured reports with severity-rated findings, file:line citations, ranked recommended actions, and an optional second-opinion reconciliation pass. Supports lens variants (safety, discoverability, architecture, parseability, tests, quick) for focused reviews.
